name: bapa-sitaram-billing
description: Restaurant billing app for Bapa Sitaram Restaurant (PWA + Capacitor iOS/Android).

scripts.ios:add: npx cap add ios && npm run assets
scripts.ios:open: npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:add: npx cap add android && npm run assets
scripts.android:open: npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
